about: Which upstream response headers an app never gets: the ones naming the account behind the key (OpenAI's
organization and project, Anthropic's organization id), which would let connected apps link one user across
sites, and server, tracing and cookie headers. Everything else reaches the app; SDKs read the request ids and
the retry and rate-limit headers. "stripped" is the whole deny-list, "kept" headers that must pass.
